intro: Earth Sapta is a replenishment ritual offered by Seer Ravenfeather in Camp Narache. Young shaman undertaking their initiation to commune with the spirits of the stone require this draught to open their inner sight. Should a novice lose or spill their prepared brew before finishing their rite, the seer prepares another to ensure their trial may continue.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Take this and remember, it is sacred.
